title: REST Adapter Mapping Configuration
description: Mapping configuration for the basis-adapters REST adapter. Defines how HTTP method + path combinations are normalized into BASIS authorization semantics.

routes.description: Ordered list of route mappings. Routes are evaluated in declaration order; the first match wins.

RouteMapping.description: Maps an HTTP method + path pattern to normalized authorization semantics.

name.description: Optional human-readable name for this route. Used in error messages and duplicate-name detection. Must be unique across all named routes in the config.

methods.description: HTTP methods this route applies to. Use ["*"] to match any method.

path_pattern.description: Path pattern with optional {param} capture groups. Must start with '/'. Example: /devices/{device_id}/points/{point_id}

resource_type.description: Normalized resource category. Passed through to the NormalizedAuthorizationRequest. Examples: point, device, schedule.

resource_id_template.description: Template for the normalized resource identifier. May reference captured path parameters using {param} syntax. All referenced captures must appear in path_pattern. Static values (e.g. "*") are also valid. Examples: "{device_id}:{point_id}", "{device_id}", "*"

action_map.description: Per-method action overrides. Keys are HTTP method names (uppercase). Values must be valid normalized action verbs. Methods not listed here fall back to the adapter's default action map.

HttpMethod.description: An HTTP method name or the wildcard '*' to match any method.
